title: LNU Lightning Complex Wildfire Response
description: U.S. Air Force Lt. Col. Glenn Cameron, 60th Civil Engineer Squadron commander, and Emergency Operations Center director during  wildfire evacuations at Travis Air Force Base, California, explains the response efforts for the LNU Lightning Complex fires that occurred in late August.
keywords: 60th Civil Engineer Squadron, LNU Lightning Complex Wildfire
